```sql
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE fiscal_year = 2026;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    order_date_local >= '2026-03-01' 
    AND order_date_local < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY 
    region
ORDER BY 
    net_revenue DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    channel,
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS total_net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    calendar_year = 2025
GROUP BY 
    channel
ORDER BY 
    total_net_revenue DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM analytics.dim_customers
WHERE first_order_on >= '2026-01-01' AND first_order_on < '2027-01-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    order_date_local >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) 
    AND order_date_local < DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '3' MONTH
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue,
    SUM(quantity) AS units_sold
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region;
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(f.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders f
JOIN analytics.fct_order_lines fl ON f.order_id = fl.order_id
JOIN analytics.dim_products p ON fl.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%tent%'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.placed_at) = 2025;
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(gross_revenue_eur) AS total_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < '2026-01-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(gross_revenue_eur) AS average_order_value
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    order_date_local BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY 
    region;
```



```sql

    region,

    analytics.fct_orders
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region, 
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    placed_at >= '2026-05-01' AND placed_at < '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY 
    region

    order_count DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2026-05-01' AND placed_at < '2026-06-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    p.category,
    SUM(ol.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM 
    analytics.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    ol.order_id IN (
        SELECT order_id 
        FROM analytics.fct_orders 
        WHERE placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < '2026-01-01'
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.category
ORDER BY 
    total_units_sold DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM analytics.fct_orders o
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.placed_at) = 2025;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.country,

    analytics.fct_orders o
WHERE 
    o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01'

    o.country

    net_revenue DESC;
```


```sql
SELECT 
    o.customer_id,
```

```sql

    c.customer_name, 
    c.email

    analytics.fct_refunds fr

    fr.amount_eur > 500
    AND fr.refunded_at >= '2026-01-01'
    AND fr.refunded_at < '2027-01-01'
```

```sql
SELECT 
    reason, 
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count
FROM 
    analytics.fct_refunds
WHERE 
    refunded_at >= '2025-01-01' AND refunded_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    reason
ORDER BY 
    refund_count DESC;
```
